_meta.description: CircuitVerse component reference — dimensions, pins, parameters, and size formulas
_meta.source: Extracted from CircuitVerse simulator JS sources
_meta.coordinate_system: Dimensions are half-extents from center (left/right/up/down). Total width = left + right, total height = up + down.
_meta.pin_coordinates: Relative to component center. type: 0 = input, 1 = output, 2 = intermediate.

inp.positions_formula: Distributed vertically centered at x = -10. For 2 inputs: [(-10, -10), (-10, 10)]. For N inputs: spaced 20px apart, centered around y=0.

size_formulas.height: Scales with inputLength: up/down = max(20, inputLength * 10)

size_formulas.height: Scales with inputLength: up/down = max(20, inputLength * 10)
Scales with inputLength: up/down = max(20, inputLength * 10)

Height scales with number of split outputs

constructor_params.name: bitWidthSplit
constructor_params.note: Array of bit widths per output. Sum must equal bitWidth.

Splitter.notes: Bidirectional — works as splitter or combiner depending on signal direction

dimensions_formula.description: Dynamic bounds based on direction and identifier length

Tunnel.notes: Wirelessly connects tunnels with the same identifier. Prevents bitWidth conflicts between paired tunnels.

constructor_params.name: layoutProperties
constructor_params.note: { x, y, id } for subcircuit layout

Input.notes: Click individual bits to toggle. Width scales linearly with bitWidth.

constructor_params.name: state
constructor_params.note: Binary string representation of the constant value

Button.notes: User-clickable momentary button. Not supported in Verilog.

Flag.notes: Measurement/monitoring probe. Records transitions for waveform display. xSize adjusts with identifier length.

TriState.notes: Passes input when enable=1, high-impedance (undefined) when enable=0.

ControlledInverter.notes: Inverts when enable=1, high-impedance when enable=0.

TwoComplement.notes: Inverts all bits and adds 1 (two's complement negation).

LSB.notes: Outputs index of lowest set bit. Enable=1 if any bit is set.

MSB.notes: Outputs index of highest set bit. Enable=1 if any bit is set.

PriorityEncoder.notes: Encodes the highest active input bit index.

DflipFlop.notes: Master-slave D flip-flop. Edge-triggered on rising clock.

SRflipFlop.notes: SR flip-flop. S=1 sets, R=1 resets. S=R=1 is invalid.

Clock.notes: User-toggleable clock source. Click to toggle 0/1.

RAM.notes: Volatile RAM. 2^addressWidth words. Async read, sync write. Memory not persisted in save.

Rom.notes: 16x8 ROM. Fixed size: 16 addresses, 8-bit data. Interactive hex editing.

EEPROM.notes: Non-volatile EEPROM. Max 1KB (addressWidth <= 10). Data persisted in save. Extends RAM.

Keyboard.notes: ASCII keyboard input buffer. Outputs one character per clock edge.

dimensions_formula.description: Width scales with cols, height with rows

TTY.notes: ASCII terminal display. One character per clock pulse. Line-wrapped.

verilogRAM.notes: Multi-port RAM with configurable read/write ports and clock/enable polarity per port.

DigitalLed.notes: Single-bit LED. Gray when 0, specified color when 1.

size_formulas.pin_offset: Pin X position moves left with pinLength: x = -10 - 10 * pinLength

SevenSegDisplay.notes: Individual segment control (a-g + dp). 8 input pins, 1 bit each.

SixteenSegDisplay.notes: 16-segment alphanumeric display. Single 16-bit input for all segments.

dimensions_formula.description: Grid of LEDs with configurable size
Dynamic based on text content and font size

Text.notes: Pure annotation. No pins, no simulation. Editable via keyboard when selected.

Arrow.notes: Decorative arrow. No pins, no simulation.

Rectangle.notes: Decorative rectangle. No pins, no simulation.

ImageAnnotation.notes: Image overlay annotation. No pins, no simulation.

Stepper.notes: Manual stepper. Click to increment/set value.

dimensions_formula.description: Loaded from referenced circuit scope's layout

constructor_params.name: id
constructor_params.note: Identifier of the referenced circuit scope

SubCircuit.notes: Hierarchical subcircuit instantiation. Dimensions and pins from referenced scope layout. Supports v1.0 and v2.0 coordinate systems.

mux_demux_decoder_sizing.description: Shared formula for Multiplexer, Demultiplexer, Decoder, PriorityEncoder

io_width_scaling.description: Input, Output, ConstantVal width scales linearly with bitWidth

splitter_height.description: Splitter height based on number of split outputs

keyboard_width.description: Keyboard width based on buffer size

tty_dimensions.description: TTY dimensions based on rows and columns

gate_input_distribution.formula: For N inputs: spaced 20px apart (10px per half), centered around y=0. Input pins at x=-10, output at x=20.

tunnel_bounds.description: Tunnel sizing based on identifier length

formula.note: Longer identifiers get more space. Direction affects which dimension expands.

annotation_sizing.description: Rectangle and ImageAnnotation use grid units
